columns.title: How the keys work
items: A key is author plus year; a letter follows when one author has several items in a year (2026a, 2026b).
Letters follow first citation, a team convention that differs from the title order strict APA 7 requires.
Keys 2025a and 2026b are unchanged from Chapters 2 and 3; their releases are dated 30 Oct 2024 and 8 Oct 2025.
Undated pages use n.d. with a letter; 14 entries are marked Retrieved because the pages change over time.
One Report 2025 pages are the printed ones; the PDF file runs four to six pages ahead.
The 2020 and 2021 annual report entries cite PDF pages.

columns.title: How the counts were made
columns.text: The counts are the team's tally, by author, of the 109 entries in the one reference list for Chapters 2 to 6. Press releases carried on a wire service are counted under their author, Central Pattana. Chapter 2 and 3 sources were in a separate list until 30 October 2026; 23 of their 56 entries share a URL with a Chapter 4 to 6 entry and appear once.

notes: Backup slide, not presented. The merged list has 109 entries for Chapters 2 to 6. By author: 47 from CPN, its investor relations site and CPNREIT, 10 from Central Group, Central Retail and The1 Central Limited, 6 official or legal texts, 12 from advisers, raters and research firms, and 34 news items.
